description_en: Queries the running status of specified devices under the same product in a batch
description_zh: 调用该接口批量查看同一产品下指定设备的运行状态
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-get-device-state --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name example-string --iot-id example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchGetDeviceState

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this value does not exist, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the devices whose running status you want to query belong.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查看运行状态的设备所属的产品ProductKey。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The list of device names whose running status you want to query.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查看运行状态的设备的名称列表。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The list of device IDs whose running status you want to query.
<notice> IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查看运行状态的设备ID列表。
<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id
